$comment: Where you stand — the rules that turn an intake into a read. Deterministic; nothing regulatory is generated at runtime (tool spec 3, 5.2-5.5). Empty at milestone 1; written at milestone 2. The acceptance tests in tool spec §5 are the definition of done. Rule 3 (stretched, never incapable) and Rule 8 (no future-tense promise) are tested on every block the rules can select.

schema.selectBlocks: ordered rules; each names a block id and the intake answers that select it. First match per cell wins; every cell ends with a fallback so no cell is ever empty.
schema.whatToDoFirst: three items, ordered by cost of delay: obligations with penalties, then visibility, then structure. Drawn from sections 1 and 2; no new content.
schema.honestLine: exactly one of the three closing blocks, by rule, never a score. The first ('you don't need an executive layer yet') renders with the files and 'Not now' only — no call-to-action to an engagement.

blocks.$comment: Stage at or before setting up, or revenue none with headcount 1. The warmest copy on the site. Three things to do yourselves, with method, and when it changes.
Needs-building items concentrated in one row, or the visitor is comfortable holding the rest. The project path, and what a quote covers.
Needs-building across three or more rows, or answer 9 shows the owner's week in finance, admin and compliance. Stated as load taken, never as inability.
